title: German Hash and Potato Gratin
description: A creamy, golden German side dish made with crispy potatoes and a rich velvety sauce.

ingredients.name: Velvety sauce
ingredients.notes: or substitute with sour cream and milk mixture

instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the sliced potatoes, hash, and melted butter. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are tender and golden brown.
In a separate saucepan, heat the velvety sauce over low heat until warm and creamy.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, arrange the potato mixture in an even layer.
Pour the warm velvety sauce over the potatoes, making sure they are fully coated.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the potatoes are heated through.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
